coverage_note: Changed executable LLVM DA lines only, not branch/project-wide coverage. Application and shared reader/dispatch reported separately. resource_summary.scope: Debug instrumented production file-index-worker, nice 10, sequential repeated extraction of the same synthetic ODT body, 100 ms between requests. No embedding, background scheduler, UI input, GPU counters or long-term thermal acceptance measured. RSS is ps resident pages; CPU percent is ps lifetime average, 100 percent per core.
